sentence_1_it: Un chilo di ketchup equivale a due chili di pomodori.
sentence_1_en: A kilo of ketchup is equivalent to two kilos of tomatoes.
sentence_2_it: Un dollaro equivale a cento centesimi.
sentence_2_en: A dollar is equal to a hundred cents.
sentence_3_it: Un metro non equivale a una yarda.
sentence_3_en: A meter is not quite equivalent to a yard.

sentence_1_it: Due pinte equivalgono a un litro.
sentence_1_en: Two pints are equal to a quart.
sentence_2_it: Trentacinque gradi centigradi equivalgono a novantacinque gradi Fahrenheit.
sentence_2_en: Thirty-five degrees centigrade equals ninety-five degrees Fahrenheit.

sentence_1_it: Alcuni anni fa, imparare che uno aveva la tubercolosi equivaleva a sentire una condanna a morte.
sentence_1_en: Some years ago, learning that one had tuberculosis amounted to hearing a sentence of death.
